Special Road Fund Program

Special Road Fund (SRF) projects are limited to roads that provide access to and/or are within recreational, tourist, and historical areas. The intent of this program is to help finance highway projects identified by political subdivisions, tribal governments and state agencies which typically have some funding but need additional help. The maximum NDDOT contribution will be limited to 80 percent, with the financial participation amount limited to $500,000.
